response.original_title: Unforgotten: A Hero’s Story of War
response.overview: Filmmaker Darrin Dick goes on a discovery to uncover the story of his Korean War veteran grandfather, Harold Bauer. A story of bravery, loss, and faith amidst the extremities of war. During an interview with his grandson and trip to the Korean War Memorial in DC, Harold opens up about his faith, family and memories from the "almost" Forgotten Korean War that he’s never told anybody before.
response.tagline: No Sacrifice Should Ever Be Forgotten
response.title: Unforgotten: A Hero’s Story of War
